title: Nintendo’s designers strove for ‘elegance’ when remaking Ocarina of Time

claims.claim: Ocarina of Time'ın yeniden yapımı (remake) Switch 2 konsolu için geliştirilmiştir.

evidence.quote: The Ocarina of Time remake on the Switch 2 smashes together the past and present.

claims.claim: Ocarina of Time'ın yeniden yapım projesi Eiji Aonuma ve Hidemaro Fujibayashi tarafından yönetilmiştir.

evidence.quote: While Ocarina’s remake was led by producers Eiji Aonuma (a director on the original game who is now the franchise’s steward at Nintendo) and Hidemaro Fujibayashi (best known for directing Breath of the Wild and its sequel)

claims.claim: Orijinal Ocarina of Time oyunu 1998 yılında Nintendo 64 platformu için piyasaya sürülmüştür.

evidence.quote: Much has changed since Ocarina of Time first debuted on the Nintendo 64 in 1998

claims.claim: Hidemaro Fujibayashi, Breath of the Wild ve devam oyununun yönetmenliğini yapmıştır.

evidence.quote: Hidemaro Fujibayashi (best known for directing Breath of the Wild and its sequel)

claims.claim: Yeniden yapım sürümünde oyunculara tam kamera kontrolü ve istedikleri yerde zıplama imkanı getirilmiştir.

evidence.quote: The team made a handful of changes, like giving players complete camera control and the ability to jump anywhere, which were designed to provide connective tissue between the remake and its present-day contemporaries.

claims.claim: Orijinal Ocarina of Time oyununda Navi karakteri, oyunculara rehberlik etmek için kullanılan bir peri karakteridir.

evidence.quote: For instance, one of the most infamous parts of the N64 Ocarina was Navi, a little fairy who serves as a guide for Link during his adventures.

claims.claim: Zelda serisi bu yıl 40. yıl dönümünü kutlamaktadır.

evidence.quote: Aonuma also felt it was important to keep Ocarina’s more traditional style of Zelda gameplay alive as the franchise celebrates its 40th anniversary this year.

claims.claim: Orijinal Ocarina of Time oyununda Z-targeting özelliği, oyuncunun düşmana kilitlenmesini sağlayan bir mekaniktir.

evidence.quote: One of the most impactful features in Ocarina is something called Z-targeting, which lets the player lock on to an enemy, making combat much more intuitive.
